first-order-convention.alt: The convention dining hall, busy with hundreds of Order members eating and talking between sessions.
first-order-convention.caption: 'It is a lot of people' - the dining hall between sessions.

first-order-convention.alt: A long line of Order members standing on the stage, many in pale-blue robes and white kesas, in front of the golden shrine pillar.
first-order-convention.caption: Everyone ordained since the last convention, introducing themselves.

first-order-convention.alt: A group of the women from my ordination retreat gathered around a table at the convention, two of them standing at the back.
first-order-convention.caption: The women from my ordination retreat, back together. Standing at the back are Bodhipakṣiṇī, who lives at Akashavana, and Mokṣagandhi, who ran our kitchen for the two-week retreat - and whose birthday we celebrated.

first-order-convention.alt: Close-up of the golden Buddha rupa on the shrine, framed by flowers, tea lights and two framed portrait photographs.
first-order-convention.caption: The main shrine, close up.

first-order-convention.alt: Two control desks lit in the dark - a digital sound mixer and a lighting console, faders and touchscreens glowing.
first-order-convention.caption: The lighting and sound desk I helped to staff.

first-order-convention.alt: A large Tibetan thangka scroll painting of Padmasambhava seated on a lotus, richly brocaded, hanging against the blue backdrop.
first-order-convention.caption: One of the thangkas in the shrine room.

first-order-convention.alt: A tall red and gold banner of the Buddha seated on a lotus, holding a flower in a teaching gesture.
A large framed artwork made of hundreds of individual painted faces forming a single shimmering image.
first-order-convention.caption: Hundreds of faces, one sangha.

first-order-convention.alt: The view from the lighting and sound desk, control surfaces in the foreground and the golden shrine glowing under the rig across the darkened room.
first-order-convention.caption: The view from behind the desk.
